purpose: Narrow blueprint-level patch for canonical purchase-evidence classification. Apply only against a freshly exported live blueprint.

required_changes: Append document_type to each prompt's exact top-level-field list.
Add one required text interface field named document_type to Parse Extraction (14) and Parse Retry Extraction JSON (45), using the shared ReceiptIt Extraction Contract data structure.
Add the explicit classification instructions from this file's contract to the initial and retry prompts.
Change the existing Not a receipt route to set status=rejected and error_reason=not_purchase_document.
Add a Document Review route before the currency and Finalise routes: is_receipt=true AND document_type in invoice,order_confirmation,payment_confirmation,hotel_folio,eftpos_slip,other_purchase_proof.

The Document Review PATCH must update only the same existing receipt, set status=needs_review, error_reason=non_standard_purchase_document, document_type={{14.document_type}}, and preserve storage_path/user_id.
Restrict both normal Finalise routes and the currency-missing route to document_type=receipt OR document_type does not exist, so old parser outputs remain backward compatible.
Append document_type to the request-builder JSON contract and add the same explicit classification instructions.
Add one required text interface field named document_type to Parse JSON (26), using the shared ReceiptIt Extraction Contract data structure.
Change the existing Not a purchase proof route to set status=rejected and error_reason=not_purchase_document.
Add a Document Review route before Currency required and Finalise: is_receipt=true AND document_type in invoice,order_confirmation,payment_confirmation,hotel_folio,eftpos_slip,other_purchase_proof.

The Document Review upsert must update the existing receipt only, set status=needs_review, error_reason=non_standard_purchase_document, document_type={{26.document_type}}, and preserve storage_path/user_id.
Restrict Currency required and the Finalise caller to document_type=receipt OR document_type does not exist.

classification_instruction: Set document_type exactly once. A completed conventional retail receipt is receipt. An invoice is invoice; an order confirmation is order_confirmation; a payment confirmation is payment_confirmation; a hotel folio is hotel_folio; an EFTPOS/payment-terminal slip is eftpos_slip; other legitimate purchase evidence is other_purchase_proof. Bank statements, screenshots, and unrelated documents are non_purchase_document. A merchant name, amount, card data, or transaction table alone never makes a document purchase evidence. Set is_receipt=false only for non_purchase_document; set it true for receipt and every valid purchase-evidence type.
structural_guards: Do not change StartSubscenario, Storage download, duplicate, Finalise caller, or module IDs outside the listed parser/router modules.
Do not send document_type=non_purchase_document or any non-standard purchase evidence through Finalise.
Document Review and rejection routes must PATCH/UPSERT the existing receipt id; they must not insert receipts, items, or payments.
The receipt document_type remains nullable so historic receipts and a safe rollback continue to work.
